name: seedance-2-0-director
title: Seedance 2.0 Director
description: Shot-list director for Seedance 2.0. Clips 4-15s, real start_image/end_image roles, fast mode rejects audio_references.

constraints.notes: fast supports 480p/720p only and rejects audio_references; 1080p/4k require std. Reference ceiling 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audio per request (the published multimodal limit; total reference video and audio each ≤15s).
